summary: Independence Realty Trust (IRT) disclosed a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger, signed September 8, 2026, to acquire Centerspace (CSR) in a two-step REIT merger. IRT Merger Sub will merge into CSR, which survives, followed immediately by a partnership merger of IRT OP Merger Sub into CSR OP. Exact consideration, exchange ratio, premium, and close date are not stated in the excerpt. IRT may restructure as upstream mergers with CSR/CSR OP surviving, provided CSR shareholder consideration and tax treatment are unchanged. Watch Form S-4/Joint Proxy timing, CSR shareholder vote and regulatory clearance.
